description: This source file defines the NodeServiceManager as an enum with static functions for managing a 'node' service, including starting, stopping, and executing commands related to it. It includes internal structures for handling command results and JSON parsing, with extensions for additional functionality and testing.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: A struct representing the result of executing a service command, including success status, payload, message, and parsed JSON data.

classes.name: ParsedServiceJson
classes.description: A struct representing the parsed JSON response from the service, containing status, messages, error info, and hints.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the node service, returning an error message if it fails.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the node service, returning an error message if it fails.
